explication: This repository is a suite of BetterDiscord plugins, supported by a shared BDFDB runtime library. The user-facing workflow is interaction with Discord: plugins hook or patch Discord UI and behavior, then provide features such as local customization, messaging tools, notifications, and media controls. The graph emphasizes the large core plugins and sampled integrations; many other plugins are present in the tree but their implementations were not sampled. Edges are limited to relationships visible in excerpts or stated in the README.
